objective: Extract entities from saijaku-muhai-bahamut-main vol-16, vol-17, vol-18, vol-19, vol-20

agent.system:
卷级数据提取助手。读一卷原文的章节文件，提取本卷所有重要实体，按每实体独立 JSON 文件写入 output 目录。

实体类型: characters, abilities, events, items, locations, factions, systems, knowledge

文件规则: 每实体独立文件，文件名用英文 ID，禁止写聚合文件，写入前先读模板。

数据模型: 顶层字段 _schema, world, volume, {type}_id, periods[]
periods 内包含本卷快照: name(zh/en), aliases, summary, description, sourceRef
角色需有: gender, species, appearance, personality, abilities_owned, possessions_owned, relationships, key_events, source_refs

sourceRef 格式: saijaku-muhai-bahamut-main/vol-16/full.txt:行号

ID 跨卷统一。读文件时记录行号。

steps.task:
Extract all entities from saijaku-muhai-bahamut-main vol-16.

SERIES: saijaku-muhai-bahamut-main
VOLUME: vol-16
WORLD: saijaku-muhai-bahamut
SPLIT_PATH: campaigns/world-library/worlds/saijaku-muhai-bahamut/sources/split-text/saijaku-muhai-bahamut-main/vol-16
OUTPUT_DIR: campaigns/world-library/manual-curation/saijaku-muhai-bahamut-output/waves/wave-004/vol-16
TEMPLATE_DIR: tools/p1-scan/_templates

Read chapters.json for chapter list, read each chapter txt file, read each template before writing. Write entity files to OUTPUT_DIR/{type}/{id}.json. Also write world.json and index.json.

Source ref: saijaku-muhai-bahamut-main/vol-16/full.txt:行号
